szoveg_eredeti:
We’re cutting robot setup from days to an afternoon with Gemini 4 Hydrogen and a new plugin for Google Antigravity:

🔘 Hydrogen understands 3D spaces better than Gemini Robotics ER 2 - and matches our larger 4 Argon model on real-world tabletop tasks, at a fraction of the cost.
🔘 Connect a supported arm and camera to your laptop, and it automatically handles the drivers, calibration, and safety checks in minutes.
🔘 Build scenes from photos or text prompts, adjust object placement and grip in chat, and test how objects are grasped and moved in MuJoCo, our physics simulator, before running on real hardware.

With this setup, you can go from a rough whiteboard sketch to a working conveyor-belt sorter in about an hour. Gemini 4 Hydrogen is available now in Google Antigravity , the Gemini API, and Google AI Studio. Find out more → https://goo.gle/4CfGVAn
